C0720.title: Man Arrested for Using AI to Forge Nearly 7,000 Nude Photos
C0720.summary: In June 2024, Beijing police apprehended former internet technician Bai, who used AI 'one-click undress' technology to batch-process others' daily photos into forged nude images. He sold nearly 7,000 such images to 351 people on social media for just 1.5 yuan each.
